title: Experiment! How Does An Owl Fly So Silently? | Super Powered Owls | BBC
summary: A BBC Earth clip from Super Powered Owls in which the team uses sensitive sound equipment to compare owl flight with other birds. It shows why owls fly almost silently.
why: Linked in owl-feather and quiet-flight threads as a clear audio comparison.

quote.text: To really appreciate how silent Owls are as compared to other birds, see this excellent video from BBC
